summary.headline: Astrological Aspects and Connections
summary.text: Discussion of the five astrological aspects—conjunction, sextile, square, trine, and opposition—including their ray projections and the roles of the inferior planet as manager or connector and the other as receiver. The Moon is always connecting, Saturn never connecting, and the conjunction of the Sun and Moon is called an assembly.
